description.content:
API to process the reversal of a transaction.

The transaction to be reversed can be referenced by:
- Its transaction ID
- The Idempotency Key used in the transaction request

The Teya FX API allows you to fetch the latest exchange rates for currency pairs and perform Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC). Use this API to verify card eligibility, retrieve real-time exchange rates, and create DCC offers with persisted quotes.
